sources.snippet: What is nli-distilroberta-base-v2? nli-distilroberta-base-v2 is a specialized sentence embedding model built on the DistilRoBERTa architecture. It maps sentences and paragraphs to a 768-dimensional dense vector space, making it particularly effective for tasks like semantic search and clustering.
